children: Petroleum Development Oman (PDO) has signed a three-year integrated drilling services contract with Weatherford covering 274 wells in Marmul and the Greater Saqar area, as part of efforts to increase production and improve operational efficiency.

Under the agreement, Weatherford will drill oil production and water injection wells through a phased programme designed to improve execution, planning and the allocation of drilling rigs and resources across the targeted fields.

PDO said the contracting model is expected to reduce costs by approximately 20 percent compared with conventional pricing models, while strengthening cost control and creating clearer accountability for execution and results.

Dr. Aflah Said Al Hadhrami, Director General of Petroleum Development Oman, said: "The company's ability to efficiently and responsibly grow production is fundamental to maximizing value from the Sultanate of Oman's hydrocarbon resources."

He added that the agreement represents another step toward production growth as a key pillar of Oman’s institutional transformation, while PDO remains committed to enhancing in-country value, developing local capabilities and investing in Omani talent.
Girish Saligram, Chief Executive Officer of Weatherford, said the contract reflects the company’s commitment to operational excellence, innovation and sustainable value creation.

He said Weatherford would support PDO’s objectives to improve production efficiency and ensure sustainable field development, while building local capabilities, developing Omani talent and expanding opportunities across the local value chain.

Saligram added: "Weatherford will remain committed to execution efficiency and maximizing the impact of in-country value, thereby contributing to supplying the energy sector in the Sultanate of Oman and supporting national development targets."

PDO said the agreement reinforces its strategy of building long-term partnerships with industry providers while combining commercial efficiency with high standards of health, safety, environment and quality.
